summary_1line: Arjuna recounts battling the illusion‑wielding Nivata‑Kavachas, countering their storms of rocks, water, fire, wind, and darkness with celestial weapons from Indra.

image_candidates.scene_text: Arjuna on his chariot fires blazing celestial arrows that shatter a rain of giant rocks falling from the sky.
Dense supernatural darkness engulfs the battlefield as Matali drops the golden lash and cries out in fear beside Arjuna’s chariot.
A colossal storm of water pours from the heavens while Arjuna releases a fiery celestial weapon that dries the torrents midair.
